title: The Brars Submit and the Kapoora Brar Episode Opens

blocks.text: This page first closes the Brar quarrel on a note of submission. After returning to the same country, the Singhs are received by humbled Brars who invite them into their homes, and those who took pahul and joined the Panth are remembered as especially blessed.

Rattan Singh then marks the account as one preserved from his father's testimony, giving the episode a deliberate narrative close before the next story begins. The hinge matters, because the page does not remain in the same mood for long.

It turns directly into the Kapoora Brar episode, where Kapoora refuses to shelter the Guru out of fear that Mughal power will punish him with death by hanging. The Guru's prophetic response becomes the moral center of the new episode.
